/bin/bash -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,os,subprocess
h=Path('/home/holden/mckernel-work/host-preparation');r=Path('.git/os-autopilot/runs/20261021T070405Z-729d8cb8/protocol.jsonl');g=h/'current-focused-progress-recording-20261021-1/current-normalization-review-recording-1'
with r.open('rb') as f:f.seek(max(0,r.stat().st_size-4000000));f.readline();lines=f.readlines()
found=[]
for raw in lines:
 try:
  e=json.loads(raw)['event']
  if e.get('method')"'!='"'turn/completed':continue
  for i in e['params']['turn']['items']:
   t=i.get('text','')
   if i.get('type')=='agentMessage' and 'PASS_ONE_EXACT_FAILED_OWNER_MINIMUM_READONLY_EXPORT_EXCEPTION' in t:
    s=t[t.index('{'):t.rindex('}')+1];v=json.loads(s)
    if v.get('reviewer')=='/root/m07_outer_control_closure_expert':found.append((raw,t,s,v))
 except Exception:continue
assert found
raw,t,s,v=found[-1];assert v['conditional_command_permission'] and v['execution_count']==1
p=g/'M07-FAILED-OWNER-MINIMUM-READONLY-EXPORT-EXCEPTION-REVIEW.json';assert not p.exists();p.write_text(s+'\\n');p.with_suffix('.verbatim.md').write_text(t);p.with_suffix('.raw-event.jsonl').write_bytes(raw)
n=h/'M07-current-profile-next-observation-preparation-20261021-1/remaining-components-functional-case-preparation-20261022-1/joint-mpx-exact-fault-correction-1/current053d-stage-preparation-1/ordinary-normalization-runtime-integration-1/outer-runtime-preparation-1/bound-runtime-control-closure-correction-1/current-normal9-role-binding-1'
e=n/'failed-owner-minimum-readback-preparation-1';pending=e/'FAILED-OWNER-MINIMUM-READBACK-COMMANDS.PENDING.json';d=json.loads(pending.read_bytes());d['release']={'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size};d['root_installed_release_path']=str(p)
a=e/'FAILED-OWNER-MINIMUM-READBACK-COMMANDS.ACTUAL.json';assert not a.exists();a.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\\n')
assert not Path(d['operations'][1]['status_path']).parent.exists()
assert os.environ.get('SUDO_ASKPASS')
state=json.loads(Path('.git/os-autopilot/state.json').read_bytes());assert state.get('stop_reason') is None and state['last_rate_limits']['primary']['usedPercent']<100
print('REVIEW',d['release'],'ACTUAL',hashlib.sha256(a.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(subprocess.call(['/home/holden/anaconda3/bin/python3.9','-I','-B',str(n/'native-packet-1/root-run-exact-readonly-stage.py'),'--commands-file',str(a),'--commands-sha256',hashlib.sha256(a.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'--index','1']))
PY"
